findings.description: OTP generation uses Math.random() which is not cryptographically secure and can be predicted by an attacker
Temporary password returned in API response body and stored in plaintext notification, visible in logs and network traces
findings.recommendation: Remove tempPassword from JSON response. If email fails, omit password from notification and provide a 'Resend credentials' feature that generates a new password

findings.description: Missing crypto import causes ReferenceError at runtime when creating notifications
findings.recommendation: Add 'import crypto from "crypto";' at the top of the file

findings.description: In-memory rate limiting resets on server restart and doesn't work across replicas
findings.recommendation: Store rate limit counters in Redis or database with TTL to persist across restarts and scale horizontally

findings.description: Google OAuth mobile endpoint referenced but not implemented, will return 404
findings.recommendation: Implement POST /api/auth/google/mobile endpoint to verify ID token and return Bearer token for mobile clients

findings.description: Commission calculation rounds commission and center earnings independently, may cause 1-cent discrepancies
findings.recommendation: Calculate centerEarnings as (price - commissionAmount) without additional rounding, or verify sum equals price

findings.description: Device headers are client-provided and trusted without cryptographic verification
findings.recommendation: Document that device IDs are client-provided. Consider adding device fingerprinting or server-side validation to detect spoofing attempts

findings.description: Flutter mobile implementation cannot be tested without emulator; runtime behavior unverified
findings.recommendation: Test mobile app with 'flutter run' on Android emulator or iOS simulator to verify network requests, token storage, navigation flows, and device header injection
